errorCodes.meaning: The event has no link with this identifier.
The link was revoked already; nothing changed.

EventId.description: Opaque identifier of an event: `evt_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-EVT-001).
EventId.title: EventId

EventInstant.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, such as `2026-11-30T18:30:00Z`.
EventInstant.title: EventInstant

EventInvitationLink.description: An invitation link as its hosts see it, never with its code (VTI-EVT-107).

label.description: What the hosts call it — `Flyer at the library`. Plain text.

maxRedemptions.description: The most members who may redeem it.

EventInvitationLink.title: EventInvitationLink

EventInvitationLinkId.description: Opaque identifier of one invitation link: `lnk_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Not the code: the code is shown once, at creation, and kept only as a digest (VTI-EVT-107).
EventInvitationLinkId.title: EventInvitationLinkId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/invitations/links/revoke/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/invitations/links/revoke/0.1#response.
Response.title: VTC Events — Invitations — Links — Revoke — response payload

schema.description: A host revokes an invitation link: its code redeems nothing from then on. Invitations already made by it stand. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.
